Exterior lighting install

Landscape lighting

Exterior landscape lighting, installed so the property you paid for does not disappear after dark.

Free estimatesResidential & commercialLake Mary & Central FL
Get a free quote Call 407-717-8191

What this is

Landscape lighting in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services installs exterior landscape lighting as part of our landscape design and construction work, or on its own for a property whose planting is already where you want it.

A paver walkway, a specimen oak and a clean facade are all things you bought and then only see in daylight. Lighting is how they keep working in the evening, which is when most people are actually home.

What's involved

How it works, and what shapes the quote.

Residential and commercial, across Lake Mary, Heathrow, Altamonte Springs, Longwood and Orlando.

01

Path and walkway

So the route from the street to the door reads at night.

02

Trees and planting

Uplighting the canopies and specimen plants worth looking at.

03

Facade and features

Light across a wall, a water feature or a paver patio.

What affects the scope

  • Which areas you want lit — paths, trees, beds, facade, patio
  • Number and type of fixtures
  • Where power is available
  • Whether it is part of a wider landscape project
  • Timers or controls
  • Existing planting the cable route has to respect

Every quote is based on the property itself — the estimate visit is where the measuring happens, and it is free.

Questions

Before you call.

Can lighting be added to a landscape you did not install?

Yes. It is often the fastest way to improve a property that is already well planted.

Is it part of the design package?

It can be. Exterior lighting is one of the features our landscape design and construction team designs and installs.

Do you do commercial lighting?

Yes — residential and commercial.
